item.title: Federal aviation investigators look into deadly Amazon cargo plane crash in Miami
item.description: Federal aviation investigators are searching for answers following a deadly cargo plane crash at Miami International Airport Sunday that killed five people and injured at least five others.

item.title: Trump administration mulls renaming USS Doris Miller
item.description: The Trump administration is considering stripping the name of an African American war hero from an aircraft carrier, even though President Trump himself praised the honor in his first term.
item.content:encoded: The Trump administration is considering stripping the name of an African American war hero from an aircraft carrier, even though President Trump himself praised the honor in his first term.

item.title: Diesel prices soar as U.S. farmers preparing for harvest continue to feel squeezed
item.description: Diesel prices have spiked just in time for corn and soybean harvests. Farmers need the fuel to bring in the crops, and many were already hurting, but there are factors offsetting this latest setback.

item.description: Fifth graders calm school kindergartners in Los Angeles. Kids take the "bike bus" in Oklahoma. High school students take in a new high school building in Oregon.
